Properties.AlarmDescription: At least one API invocation failed in the last five minutes. Check the API logs and matching trace before retrying the action.
At least one worker invocation failed in the last five minutes. SQS retries transient failures automatically. Check the worker logs and model access if the failure repeats.
At least one website invocation failed in the last five minutes. Check the website logs and corresponding trace.
The oldest queued investigation has waited over 15 minutes across two checks. Check worker concurrency, retry status, and queue visibility before submitting more work.
At least one investigation reached the dead-letter queue. Check its saved job state and worker logs. Maintenance records the failure; replay requires current access and workspace checks.
At least one investigation failed access, input, or report validation in the last five minutes. The app stopped the investigation. Check worker logs and the saved job before starting another run.

Properties.AlarmDescription: At least one webhook receiver invocation failed in the last five minutes. Check the receiver logs and saved delivery-verification receipt. An uncertain result requires manual investigation.

At least one change workflow failed in the last five minutes. Open its Step Functions execution and review saved action receipts. Workflow failure does not establish that a configuration change occurred; do not repeat an action blindly.
At least one workflow reached its 24-hour limit. Review its Step Functions history and saved action receipts. Approval, execution, and verification are separate manual actions.

import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from urllib.parse import quote

import boto3

sns = boto3.client("sns")

TITLES = {
    "switchboard-Throttles": "Traffic exceeded available capacity",
    "switchboard-APIErrors": "An API request failed",
    "switchboard-WorkerErrors": "An investigation needs a retry",
    "switchboard-WebsiteErrors": "The website returned an error",
    "switchboard-ReceiverErrors": "The delivery receiver returned an error",
    "switchboard-QueueBacklog": "Investigations are waiting too long",
    "switchboard-DeadLetterJobs": "An investigation exhausted its retries",
    "switchboard-RejectedJobs": "An investigation was rejected",
    "switchboard-WorkflowFailures": "A change workflow failed",
    "switchboard-WorkflowTimeouts": "A change workflow timed out",
}


def handler(event, context):
    for record in event["Records"]:
        # 1. Read the alarm metadata without forwarding the raw metric payload.
        alarm = json.loads(record["Sns"]["Message"])
        name = alarm["AlarmName"]
        title = TITLES.get(name, "An operational alert needs review")
        detected = datetime.fromisoformat(alarm["StateChangeTime"]).astimezone(
            timezone.utc
        )

        # 2. Describe the problem and link directly to investigation steps.
        preview = alarm.get("TestNotification", False)
        heading = (
            "Formatting preview: no new failure was detected."
            if preview
            else "Switchboard needs attention"
        )
        link = (
            "https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1"
            "#alarmsV2:alarm/" + quote(name, safe="")
        )
        message = (
            heading
            + "\n\n"
            + title
            + "\n\n"
            + alarm["AlarmDescription"]
            + "\n\n"
            + "Detected: "
            + detected.strftime("%d %b %Y, %H:%M UTC")
            + "\n\n"
            + "Open the alarm:\n"
            + link
            + "\n\n"
            + "Troubleshooting guide:\n"
            + "https://github.com/HanifCarroll/b2b-saas-internal-agent/blob/main/aws/README.md"
        )

        # 3. Deliver through the existing confirmed email subscription.
        sns.publish(
            TopicArn=os.environ["ALERTS_TOPIC_ARN"],
            Subject=("TEST — " if preview else "") + "Switchboard: " + title,
            Message=message,
        )
    return {"formatted": len(event["Records"])}
